about: Every mounted route either asks who is calling or is listed here with a decision and a reason. `public` = reachable with no caller ON PURPOSE. `must_ask` / `retire` = declared and not yet done (owed). scripts/auth_perimeter.py reads the MOUNTED application against this list and fails on any route that is neither. A route added later must be decided when it is added. Nothing here turns authentication on.
decided: 2026-10-12 (W683), by the delivery assistant under the Owner's ruling that brought the readiness round forward. The Owner may move any line.
what_this_does_not_say: That a route which asks also checks the record belongs to the caller; that the pages send a token; behaviour with authentication on beyond what the guard drives.
